description: Machine-readable ADK guardrail catalogue (groups A–F, levels L1–L5). Profiles, certify, the dev MCP server and docs read this file.

levelLabels.L1: Cannot — host refuses at run time
levelLabels.L2: Will not build — type error or check failure
levelLabels.L3: Will not ship — certify fails or host refuses enable
levelLabels.L4: Needs a person — evidence-pack diff acknowledgement

entries.fixHint: Work only in this addon repository. Import Kassis as @kassis/* packages; never edit core or host paths.
Import only from @kassis/* and this addon's src/. Remove host paths and container.resolve calls.
Remove mail, scheduler, upload, auth, ORM, alternate UI kit, or LLM provider SDKs from package.json; use ctx facades.
Do not add private approval, notification, audit, or user tables; use core facades and record types.
State in the manifest or evidence pack which core record type each owned table replaces and why.
Prefer configuration, then declarative addon features, then code. Record the rung and reason in the change summary.
Run kassis-addon plan and map each Must requirement before writing code.
Run kassis-addon requirements so every Must row is named by a test under test/ or an entry in GAPS.md.
When core lacks a feature, stop and record the smallest facade or extension point in GAPS.md; do not build a private copy.
When over a soft budget (tables, routes, dependencies, code size), add a written reason the approver acknowledges.
Declare a permission per route and record every write through ctx.data or a facade with a manifest audit action.
Give each published event a schema and handle null when a consumed capability is absent.
Ship a down script for every up script or mark the migration irreversible with a reason in the SQL.
Describe any wider permissions, egress hosts, or data access in the change summary before certify.
Run kassis-addon certify and fix every error so checks.json records exit 0 for each machine check.
Update Kassisdoc business and/or technical pages, README.md, and CHANGELOG.md when the change affects them.
Limit edits to files and behaviour the task asked for; revert drive-by refactors.
Run kassis adk sync, read pinned guardrails, then kassis-addon attest with one answer per guardrail before certify.
Implement mandatory extension callbacks; do not ship return-true stubs or empty delete handlers.
